name: Fumio
bio:
A mischievous boy who thrives on his over-the-top confidence, optimism and unhinged humor.

Upon receiving the news that the Author Gods requested structured training for him and his friends following a devastating loss, Fumio fully grasped the gravity of the stakes, and yet never hesitated to step forward. Driven by a desire to forge his own distinct identity rather than remaining an ordinary kid, he approached his mother with absolute resolve, convincing her to train him in her former craft and pass down the grueling path of the Spirit World Warrior. As a kid influenced by his treasured memories and passions, Fum-Fum faces the new abnormal world he lives in with a smile that, in his own words, could probably last him a decade or two.
occupation: Student / Spirit World Warrior in Training

abilities.name: Glaciate Barrier
abilities.desc: His bloodline allows him to create barriers at will

abilities.name: Naginatajutsu
abilities.desc: Trained to wield his signature naginata like a butter knife

abilities.name: Acrobatics
abilities.desc: Posseses extraordinary agility and body coordination for parkour and tricky maneuvers

name: Alicia
bio:
A hyperactive girl who rivals the sun itself in radiance. To the public, she can be seen as the little sister of the group. But in reality, she's more akin to a golden retriever. She cuddles her friends to death, is obnoxiously loud, and is hard to control.

Alicia’s natural talent is matched only by her boundless confidence, a trait that occasionally lands her directly in trouble. Rather than letting setbacks crush her spirit, she views every single mistake as a vital learning curve, burning every misstep vividly into her memory to ensure she never repeats it. While her peers and mentors frequently sigh and plead, "Please don't make a habit of that".

abilities.name: Hyper-Metabolic Acceleration
abilities.desc: Her body burns energy at extreme rates, letting her move, react, and process information at lightning speeds.

abilities.name: Marksmanship
abilities.desc: Her honed skills in Archery refined her precision to hit targets and weak spots.

abilities.name: Natural Prodigy
abilities.desc: An innate ability to pick up virtually any skill almost instantly and excel at it with little to no effort.

name: Vyse
bio:
An aesthetically gifted boy who takes the breath out of everyone in the room just by breathing the same air as them. Secretly, his introverted self hates the attention, leading him to cling to his friends. To him, they make him feel normal and less of someone who is famous for being... famous.

For the greater part of his childhood, Vyse was an emotional blank slate, displaying a near-total lack of personality that left his parents struggling just to elicit a genuine feeling from him. His world shifted dramatically once he forged bonds with his friends. Surrounded by their influence, the walls broke down, allowing him to finally experience genuine emotion, act like a normal kid, and discover the simple joy of having fun.

abilities.name: Cryomancy
abilities.desc: Can drastically drop ambient temperatures, rapidly flash-freezing surroundings and manipulating dense ice structures or weapons.

abilities.name: Figure Skater
abilities.desc: Zero-friction across any terrain at will, allows him to skate effortlessly (and gracefully) at high speeds.

abilities.name: Phase Submersion
abilities.desc: Can temporarily phase through solid structures like walls or ground by holding his breath, treating solid matter like a liquid medium.

name: Riku.EXE
bio:
The only son of the Shindou Family, a true boy genius.

He tries everything he can to be more of his father, masking his shortcomings behind a cold and abrasive exterior. But deep inside resides his mother's heart that treats every living thing with respect.

Armed with a newly upgraded artificial body, Riku shares his sisters' ambition to follow in their father's footsteps and enlist in the military, confident that his advanced specs and unique capabilities would be an absolute asset to the force. Much to his annoyance, however, there are no shortcuts to rank—he is still bound to the traditional path of enlistment. To prove his qualifications, Riku has to jump through the standard bureaucratic hoops, starting with enduring the tedious reality of school just to secure a piece of paper.

abilities.name: Cyber-Engineering
abilities.desc: Genius-level intellect for designing and crafting advanced gear like his custom aeroboard, heavy combat hammer, and signature green visualizers.

abilities.name: Spirit-Bound Card Manipulation
abilities.desc: Allows him to channel, throw, and manipulate spectral cards infused with spirit energy

abilities.name: Military Tactical Intellect
abilities.desc: possesses deep, insider knowledge of high-level military protocol and lingo

name: Emma
bio:
The adopted swiss girl whose one goal is to spread happiness and spoil the ones she loves with her generosity. Once you're caught under her spell, you can never break out, and she'll give you two big reasons why.

Emma stands as the undisputed heart and most hardworking member of her group. No matter how demanding her own life becomes, she continuously finds the time and energy to care for every single one of her friends. Uninterested in grand recognition or material reward, the only payment Emma ever desires for her dedication is seeing the genuine, happy smiles of friends and family.

abilities.name: Comforting Presence
abilities.desc: Posseses a calming, therapeutic nature designed to make people smile.

abilities.name: Angelic Vocals
abilities.desc: Sweet, calm, and nurturing voice, often bringing a comforting or "healing" tone to her songs and dialogue

abilities.name: Maid Persona
abilities.desc: "Big sister" personality lets her help people regardless of intense tasks.

name: Karin
bio:
The sophisticated beauty hailing from the countryside, Karin is the absolute manifestation of the word "alluring." On the surface, her cool, seductive composure makes her appear completely unshakeable—though those who manage to get closer quickly realize her demeanor is far more akin to being hilariously "aloof." Whether that contrast is a turn-off or the complete opposite is entirely up to the observer, but Karin guards that clumsy side fiercely, determined not to let just anyone see past her polished exterior.

Behind closed doors, Karin keeps her private life strictly under wraps, with only a select, trusted handful within her circle aware of the unexpectedly grounding lifestyle she actually lives. Yet despite her guarded nature and preference for privacy, she treasures her bonds deeply; when it comes to hanging out and socializing, she wouldn't trade her chaotic group of friends for anything in the world.

abilities.name: Umbral Construct Manipulation
abilities.desc: Manipulates shadows into floor-anchored strands to trap targets or shape into whip-like weapons for combat.

abilities.name: Shadow-Tether Tracking
abilities.desc: Latches shadow strands onto targets to track their locations, eavesdrop from a distance, or pull herself toward them.

abilities.name: Psychological Subterfuge
abilities.desc: Master of social deception, seamlessly extracting high-value intelligence from targets for her and her team's benefit.

name: Fumiko
bio:
As the hardworking and undeniably trusty Secretary of the Nijigasaki Student Council, Fumiko is the definition of operational perfection—there is virtually nothing she cannot handle or resolve to get the job done. Yet beneath her immaculate professional record lies a deep-seated craving for excitement.

When this seemingly ordinary girl somehow got roped into a circle full of supernatural outliers living in a world brimming with gods and magic, Fumiko embraced the chaos with open arms, viewing the extraordinary world of her peers as the ultimate escape from her usual, boring everyday life.

abilities.name: Perfunctory
abilities.desc: Does her duties routinely without any care, deep interest, or enthusiasm

abilities.name: Jack-of-all-trades
abilities.desc: can do many different practical tasks regardless of expertise

abilities.name: Crisis Responder
abilities.desc: Resists high stress, leaving only the main task to solve.

name: Setsuna
bio:
The Student Council President's alter ego who became an urban legend in Nijigasaki High. An endless source of passion, energy and charisma.

She's not afraid to show enthusiasm for her obsessions, sometimes she just can't help it. If the stars align, we might see her favorite light novel referenced in her next live performance.

abilities.name: Vocal Powerhouse
abilities.desc: possesses a powerful, high-energy singing voice and impressive range

abilities.name: Stage Presence
abilities.desc: She is known for her fiery passion, charismatic delivery, and bright scarlet-themed performances

abilities.name: Double Life
abilities.desc: Acts as the strict, proper, and orderly student council president who maintains high academic standards

name: Shioriko
bio:
A serious and meticulous girl, Shioriko operates under the firm belief that every action must serve a clear, defined purpose. She habitually observes those around her from a distance, analyzing their habits and strengths to help them reach their true potential—even if her sharp, blunt honesty causes her to come across as cold and unfeeling at first glance.

Beneath her rigid exterior lies a fundamentally good person who genuinely wants to see others succeed. Though her intense pragmatism often creates a barrier between her and her peers, Shioriko harbors a deep, quiet yearning to connect with others on a personal level, constantly balancing her strategic nature with her unspoken desire for meaningful companionship.

abilities.name: Analytical Observation
abilities.desc: Reads body language and behavior to identify a person's hidden strengths, emotional vulnerabilities, and personal limits.

abilities.name: Vulnerability Mapping
abilities.desc: Spotlights flaws in plans, organizational systems, or personal dynamics simply by watching from the sidelines, finding exactly where things need improvement.

abilities.name: Strategic Profiling
abilities.desc: Evaluates a person's core potential at a glance, guiding others toward their ideal path without ever putting herself in the center of attention.

name: Rikki
bio:
An unstable, nameless artificial human created by the Nefarious Satsujin Clan through the combined blood of two Authors.

Given the name "Rikki" by Fumio, his artificial anatomy leaves him with an unstable physical structure—causing him to shiver uncontrollably and act noticeably strange. Despite his bizarre bodily quirks, he is completely healthy and unbothered by them. Having escaped his chaotic creation, he asks for nothing more than an ordinary life free from trauma and conflict.

abilities.name: Construct Appendages
abilities.desc: Releases three biological tentacles from his back. Each tentacle is permanently fused with a massive spectral weapon construct: an axe, a halberd, and a greatsword.

abilities.name: Coywolf Instincts
abilities.desc: Inherits the razor-sharp survival senses of an apex predator, designed to kill. Grants him hyper-aware environmental tracking, pack-oriented awareness, and an uncanny knack for detecting danger before it strikes.

abilities.name: Autonomous Muscle Memory
abilities.desc: Bypasses his erratic mental reflexes entirely by allowing his body to act on raw physical instinct in response to threats before his mind even processes the action.

name: George
bio:
Ask him where he’s from, what's his story, or why he is what he is, and George will either change the subject or give you the cold shoulder.

What could the answer be to his reasons of being such an enigma? It's either he's hiding from something... or just really dramatic.

abilities.name: Telepathic Cognition
abilities.desc: Possesses the capacity for direct cognitive interception, allowing to access and interpret a person's unspoken thoughts

abilities.name: Retrocognitive Scry
abilities.desc: Projects their conciousness backwards to an individual's timeline to observe their past memories

abilities.name: Drawback: Neural Strain
abilities.desc: Using abilities triggers migraines and neorological burnouts from the unfiltered noise.

name: Makoto
bio:
Arrogant, calculating, and dangerously intelligent, Makoto operates on the single belief that the world is a stage meant for him to rule. He directs that intellect entirely toward personal dominance.

A master of subtle manipulation, gaslighting, and truth-bending, He smoothly rewrites narratives to turn allies against each other and position himself as indispensable. He treats every interaction as a transaction and every person as a piece on a board, stopping at absolute nothing to seize total authority.

abilities.name: Psychological Warfare
abilities.desc: Master-level grasp of human behavior, gaslighting, and cold reading. He can isolate individuals, create false narratives, and break someone's confidence or alliances purely through conversation.

abilities.name: Cold-Calculated Strategy
abilities.desc: Exceptional analytical intellect capable of mapping out complex, multi-step contingency plans, anticipating responses, and leveraging environmental or political situations to his absolute advantage.

abilities.name: Charismatic Authority
abilities.desc: Possesses an imposing, persuasive presence that naturally coerces peers, superiors, and authority figures into following his lead or granting him influence.

name: Megumi
bio:
Raised in a strictly controlled environment, Megumi grew up isolated from standard childhood experiences, leaving her quiet, guarded, and unsure of how to express her feelings. The only constant presence she found comfort in was her protective, highly restrictive older twin-brother.

Her worldview shifted permanently after crossing paths with the 2nd Generation crew, whose chaotic warmth exposed her to everything she missed, forcing her out of her shell to experience the real world for the first time.

abilities.name: Cognitive Aptitude
abilities.desc: Has an advanced technical proficiency in digital infrastructure

abilities.name: Insightful Empathy
abilities.desc: an innate ability to see right through people when they are hiding their true feelings, intentions, or struggles.

abilities.name: Reserved Endurance
abilities.desc: Possesses exceptional patience and mental focus under pressure, allowing her to stay calm and rational when chaos breaks out around her. [ 1st Generation ]

name: Meari
bio:
Abducted at a young age, Meari was forced into the brutal training of a Spirit World Warrior, molded specifically as an instrument for world destruction. The immense trauma fractured her psyche, splitting her original whimsical, lighthearted spirit off into a distinct alternate personality while her primary persona turned cold, distant, and survival-driven.

After escaping the exploiter's grasp, she found a warm, nurturing environment during her teenage years that allowed her past wounds to heal, eventually enabling both fractured sides of her identity to reconcile and merge into a single, complete self. Today, she has buried her dark past to fulfill her true dream as a well-renowned chef.

abilities.name: Glaciate Barriers
abilities.desc: Can instantly manifest dense, semi-transparent frozen spatial walls with her hands

abilities.name: Naginata Mastery
abilities.desc: Masterful proficiency in a fluid, spear-and-blade combat.

abilities.name: Culinary Expertise
abilities.desc: World-class skill in flavor profiling, preparation, and kitchen leadership, turning cooking into a genuine medium for connection and healing.

name: Hanzo
bio:
Born into a wealthy and influential lineage, Jubei was labeled from birth as the harbinger of a ruinous prophecy, stranding him with an unnerving streak of perpetual bad luck. Shunned by his family and subjected to harsh labor while his siblings thrived, his ordeal culminated in a death sentence by drowning.

Surrounding circumstances allowed him to survive the execution, escape his family's shadow, and forged a new path. Though his early life was defined by cruelty, he eventually found the genuine warmth and affection he was denied as a child, now standing as the proud co-owner of the renowned restaurant brand Parhelion.

abilities.name: Dual-Era Combat Arts
abilities.desc: Mastered lethal Kenjutsu and Katana techniques throughout his youth from the Author Gods themselves, seamlessly transitioning in adulthood into high-level hand-to-hand martial arts to adapt to any range or scenario.

abilities.name: Conditioned Tolerance
abilities.desc: A harrowing byproduct of lifelong mistreatment, his body possesses an unnaturally high pain threshold and durability, allowing him to push through severe physical trauma that would instantly incapacitate others.

abilities.name: Latent Spiritual Aura
abilities.desc: gained the ability to harness inner spirit energy. He can channel this latent energy to drastically amplify his physical strikes, project concentrated force, and heighten his combat reflexes beyond normal human limits.

name: Satoshi
bio:
Blessed with exceptional talent and physical prowess from a young age, Satoshi was widely expected to achieve greatness. Despite the constant praise, encounters with people in poverty during his childhood taught him to remain grounded, humble, and deeply appreciative of his gifts. His life took a drastic turn when he uncovered a long-kept family secret: the existence of a twin brother hidden from both him and his younger sister.

Abandoning his comfortable life, he embarked on a lengthy search that eventually led him to Uranoshiya High School. He now works as the school’s gym teacher and varsity basketball coach, determined to instill the discipline and mentality needed to bring the institution its very first championship.

abilities.name: Ignited Speed
abilities.desc: Blends explosive, high-speed movement with pyrokinesis, blitzing the battlefield in brief bursts of speed while coating his strikes, footsteps, or weapons in intense, controllable fire.

abilities.name: Dual Blade Fluidity
abilities.desc: Exceptional mastery over traditional swordsmanship and Katana techniques to expose enemy defense

abilities.name: Adaptive Prodigy
abilities.desc: A rare physical genius that allows him to pick up any sport or athletic discipline almost instantly, achieving a high level of proficiency and strategic understanding after only a few attempts.

name: Michan
bio:
The gentle and sweet-natured daughter of an Author God, Michan’s early years were overshadowed by deceptive and malicious individuals who took advantage of her innocence, tricking her into believing their mistreatment was normal. The resulting trauma left her with a deep-seated fear of men and severe personal insecurities.

However, through the unwavering support of genuine connections and a safe environment, she slowly unlearned her trauma, reclaimed her autonomy, and grew past her fears. Today, she lives a peaceful, fulfilling life, content and satisfied with the quiet happiness she earned for herself.

abilities.name: Alchemical Concoctions
abilities.desc: Brews potions to heal, harm, or manipulate target behavior and status.

abilities.name: Scythe Mastery
abilities.desc: Wields a scythe for wide-reach, high-lethality melee combat.

abilities.name: Unqualified Triage
abilities.desc: Performs fast, effective emergency first aid using raw instinct and improvised materials.

name: Matsuda
bio:
The son of an Author God, Matsuda was subjected to ruthless, military-grade firearms training from a young age to forge him into an elite S-Class Soldier. His life became entirely defined by a single-minded vow: to protect his sister from any further pain, regardless of the toll it took on his own safety.

After integrating into Michan’s circle, he slowly unlearned his hyper-vigilance, let down his guard, and built genuine trust with others. Today, he lives as a calm, settled family man, resting easy with the peace he fought so hard to secure and the knowledge that his sister is is in the hands of a good, semi-tolerable man

abilities.name: Eagle Precision
abilities.desc: Hits virtually any target with near-perfect accuracy using ranged firearms.

abilities.name: Counter Mastery
abilities.desc: Executes high-level hand-to-hand combat maneuvers designed to parry and counter incoming strikes.

abilities.name: Akuma's Heritage
abilities.desc: Taps into his divine bloodline to temporarily augment all physical traits and combat abilities.

name: Kaito
bio:
Gentle and submissive by nature, Kaito stands out as the calm, rational center of the Author group. Beneath his mild demeanor lies a master strategist with exceptional mastery across a broad arsenal of weapons. Even after suffering the tragic loss of his love interest at a young age, he maintains strict emotional control, earning a reputation among his peers as the most sane and grounded member of the team.

Because he lacks the intimidating presence and overt toughness of his comrades, younger recruits often underestimate and pick on him. However, those doubts vanish the moment he steps into battle, demonstrating precisely why his tactical genius and combat skills make him an irreplaceable asset. When he isn't executing high-stakes operations, he simply wishes the Author God he serves would grant him an occasional break.

abilities.name: Arsenal Mastery
abilities.desc: Adapts instantly to virtually any weapon, switching fluidly between firearms, melee, and specialized gear mid-combat.

abilities.name: Grand Strategist
abilities.desc: Calculates high-level tactics on the fly, predicting enemy movements and devising flawless battlefield plans.

abilities.name: Endless Endurance
abilities.desc: Operates with near-limitless stamina, sustaining focus and effort far longer than even the most extreme night owls.

name: Minna
bio: Born into the Takashima family, Minna was disowned early in life and sought refuge in literature, using books to cope with isolation while developing an exceptionally high IQ. Despite being shy and plagued by self-doubt, her warmth naturally draws people to her, making her surprisingly adept at forging deep connections. In her adulthood, she believed she was living her absolute dream beside her childhood crush, only to suffer a devastating betrayal when she was abandoned and replaced once he grew bored of her. Devastated by the heartbreak, Minna now lives in complete isolation, cutting off all contact from both her friends and family.

abilities.name: Genius Intellect
abilities.desc: Uses her high IQ and extensive literary knowledge to analyze situations, spot patterns, and solve complex problems rapidly.

abilities.name: Magnetic Presence
abilities.desc: Unconsciously projects a gentle, relatable aura that lowers the guards of those around her and earns their trust.

abilities.name: Absolute Reclusion
abilities.desc: Enters a state of complete emotional and sensory detachment, making her untraceable and difficult to reach or influence.

name: Rikka
bio:
Grounded, razor-sharp, and perpetually five steps ahead of everyone else, Rikka is the undisputed bedrock of her group. Having carried her unmatched organizational talents from her days as a legendary Student Council President into adulthood, she balances her terrifying foresight with a warm, dry-witted humor that keeps her peers grounded. Rather than ruling with an iron fist, she guides others through deadpan wisdom, casual teasing, and an innate ability to read people instantly.

Behind her cool demeanor and relentless work ethic lies a woman who simply wants her team to survive their own chaos—mostly so she can actually finish her paperwork and enjoy a quiet moment. Whenever someone in her circle loses their way or faces a complete catastrophe, Rikka is the very first person they call to fix it.
occupation: Chief of Staff / Strategic Operations Manager

abilities.name: Umbral Echolocation
abilities.desc: Emits silent acoustic pulses through shadows and air, mapping out entire structures, tracking heartbeats, and detecting enemy movements through solid barriers.

abilities.name: Shadow-Acoustic Intercept
abilities.desc: Pinpoints sound signatures with absolute accuracy, allowing her to move instantaneously through dark spaces and intercept hostiles before they can harm her allies.

abilities.name: Sonic Umbra
abilities.desc: Manipulates shadow-bound soundwaves to mute surrounding noise for stealth extractions or release localized sonic bursts that disorient and neutralize attackers in close quarters.

name: Meili
bio:
As the Princess of the Grand Kingdom of Rulnei, Meili grew tired of passively waiting for a proper suitor to claim her hand in marriage. Seeking purpose, she mistakenly aligned herself with the Satsujin Clan, only to be manipulated into helping conquer civilizations before being callously discarded once her usefulness ran out.

Her awakening as an Author offered her a second chance at life, allowing her to claim true independence, earn the honor of her royal title on her own terms, and accept that her homeland no longer required her as a princess. Though saddened in adulthood as her original companion group drifted apart onto separate paths, she eventually found renewed purpose and a vibrant new circle while working alongside the Irregular Hunters.

abilities.name: Gale Force
abilities.desc: Controls and manipulates sharp, high-velocity wind currents granted by her Author status.

abilities.name: Hidden Brawn
abilities.desc: Leverages her sleeper build to hide her immense physical strength that rivals the brawn of seasoned male fighters.

abilities.name: Combat Sambo
abilities.desc: Utilizes specialized military grappling, throws, and striking techniques to neutralize opponents in close quarters.

name: Aika
bio: Bright, jovial, and resilient, Aika carries a warm energy that belies a heavy past. Having spent almost her entire life operating within military ranks, she spent years being treated as a trophy and an object to be possessed—a reality that constantly threatened the safety of those she cared about most. To break the cycle and safeguard her loved ones, she stepped away from her past to rebuild her life from the ground up. She found a fresh start at the Irregular Hunter base, discovering a familiar operational environment that finally offered her a healthy, safe, and supportive community.

abilities.name: Master Comms Relay
abilities.desc: Coordinates team communications flawlessly under extreme battlefield conditions, maintaining secure, real-time command loops across complex operational zones.

abilities.name: Close-Quarters Specialist
abilities.desc: Highly proficient in personal hand-to-hand combat and defensive tactics, allowing her to rapidly neutralize threats and hold her ground in tight spaces.

abilities.name: Disarming Charm
abilities.desc: Uses her striking appearance and charismatic presence to manipulate, distract, or deceive targets into revealing crucial intelligence and granting access.

name: Akira
bio:
Shrouded in mystery to most who meet him, Akira is at core an exceptionally disciplined soldier who simply executes every mission with absolute perfection. Frequently deployed on high-stakes military operations, he serves directly under an Author God—whose relentless demands leave him quietly wishing for a break from time to time.

Relentlessly methodical, Akira refuses to rely on luck or bravado. He adheres strictly to the safest, most consistent tactical strategies, shutting down any plan that carries even the smallest percentage of uncalculated risk. For him, mission success and total risk mitigation are non-negotiable.

abilities.name: Anatomic Neutralization
abilities.desc: Leverages exact physical mechanics and minimal force to instantaneously disarm, incapacitate, or kill a target with micro-adjustments and joint manipulation.

abilities.name: Demolitions Expert
abilities.desc: Demonstrates complete mastery over high-grade explosives, enabling precise breach-and-clear maneuvers, rapid terrain destruction, and ordnance disposal.

abilities.name: Ultimatum Resolution
abilities.desc: Evaluates extreme binary choices and forced trade-offs under high pressure, instantly identifying and selecting the mathematically optimal outcome every single time.

name: Mira
bio:
Raised in a family-owned fish business, Mira started out as a sweet, timid student helper whose clumsiness and anxiety constantly got the better of her. Her quiet life took an unexpected turn when Leng stopped to help her pick up dropped papers, instantly awakening her hidden affinity for brooding, goth aesthetics. Driven by this new fascination, she pushed past her nervous nature to reach out and forge a bond with him, ultimately getting pulled into the wild dynamics of his circle.

In adulthood, Mira embraced her roots while growing into her own confidence, transforming into an extraordinarily skilled fisherman and master fish butcherer. Fulfilling her lifelong heart’s desire, she balances her craft with being a devoted, deeply loving mother.

abilities.name: Master Angler
abilities.desc: Possesses absolute mastery over fishing techniques, water navigation, and marine life behavior across all aquatic environments.

abilities.name: Precision Processing
abilities.desc: Executes flawless, highly efficient butchering on any sea creature, instantly identifying vital weak spots and maximizing high-yield harvesting.

abilities.name: Ocean Intuition
abilities.desc: Reads subtle atmospheric and oceanic shifts to predict storms, heavy waves, and sudden environmental hazards long before they arrive.

name: Leng
bio:
Raised within a clan that takes fierce pride in forging cold, lethal assassins, Leng was conditioned from birth to execute every contract without failure. That streak ended when a target protected by the Author Gods foiled his assignment. Anticipating ruthless punishment from his own family for his failure, Leng was instead offered a path of mercy by the Author Gods: serve them in exchange for his life. Recognizing the far healthier, more humane environment they offered, he accepted and quietly severed all ties with his clan.

As an adult, Leng operates as a versatile and tireless provider. To support his family, he balances his duties as a direct servant to the Author Gods alongside selective freelance assassination contracts and various side jobs.
occupation: Author Gods' Servitor / Freelance Assassin / Multi-Job Contractor

abilities.name: Dollar-Store Staff
abilities.desc: Channels frost energy through his staff to manipulate ice effortlessly, generating freezing fields and constructs without draining his stamina.

abilities.name: Glacial Glide
abilities.desc: Lays down smooth paths of ice to speed-skate across terrain, achieving high-velocity mobility without needing to sprint or run.

abilities.name: Absolute Presence Erasure
abilities.desc: Suppresses all auditory and physical presence at will, allowing him to move in total, dead silence during infiltrations and executions.
